sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following relief:
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the
Respondent Nos. 2 and 3 for making prompt, proper and fair investigation in Case
Crime No. 19 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 377, 313, 323, 506 Ipc and 3/4 of Dowry
Prohibition Act, Police Sttion-Shahganj, District- Prayagraj and conclude
investigation within stipulated period as prescribed in the Act, and also take
consequential appropriate legal action against the accused persons by arresting them
in the aforesaid case crime.
(ii) Issue such other and further orders which this Hon'ble Court deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case.

Subuhi Naseem vs State Of Up And 5 Others on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46167472/
1 (iii) Award the cost of the writ to petitioner."

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though the FIR in the instant case has been registered on 14.2.2023, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the Commissioner of Police,
Prayagraj, District-Prayagraj, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved before the Commissioner of Police, Prayagraj,
District-Prayagraj, the Commissioner of Police, Prayagraj, District-Prayagraj/respondent no. 2 shall ensure the fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5. With the aforesaid order, the present petition stands disposed of.
